Thoughtful start some small changes for anyone with a companion animal
Please read this before you travel
Travel notice for companion animals

Travelers should know that the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways reviews each booking with care and helps keep pet travel orderly and calm. Our staff record service changes in the desk ledger, and the department shares practical instructions with crews so that the journey can be handled smoothly.

Please check that your animal is fit to travel, that its carrier is secure, and that all required papers are ready for review. If plans change, tell the desk as soon as possible so the record can be updated and the right support can be arranged. We encourage travelers to keep water, identification, and comfort items close at hand, and to follow crew guidance from the moment of check-in through arrival. If Simba, or any other pet, seems unwell, unsettled, or difficult to handle, please raise the concern at once so staff can respond in a safe and reassuring way.

Our aim is to make every journey manageable for you and humane for your companion animal. Please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk before departure so we can help you travel with confidence.
